public_rationale: The linked research supports exponentially greater data needs for a particular zero-shot performance relationship. It does not establish exponentially increasing financial cost for each model improvement. Other research shows that methodological changes can improve performance and computational efficiency together, but the available comparison does not directly test this claim in its target period.
limitations: Data volume, compute use and financial cost are different measures.
Results across concepts cannot automatically be generalized to successive model generations.
The finding is unresolved, not evidence that improvement is inexpensive.
